 Karrueche Tran is keeping it all the way real about wanting to go under the knife. But chileeee, she really kept it a stack when she spilled whether her man, Deion Sanders , would drop that BAG to cover the costs. Karrueche claims that Coach Prime  is down to foot the bill, but he has ONE wild rule if he does decide to pay for her procedure.

 Karrueche Tran Reveals The Catch Behind Deion Sanders’ Offer
 Tran gave the TL the ultimate kiii when she spilled about Deion Sanders’ wild request if he decides to pay for the boob job she’s been wanting. During an episode of her podcast, ‘The Pop Exchange Show,,’ Karrueche told her co-host Jason Kennedy that she’s been thinking about getting her breasts done. The actress admitted that she’s been “juggling with getting them done,” but Coach Prime has said he doesn’t think she needs them. “He’s like ‘you’re fine.’ Karrueche added, “I love that it’s reassuring.”  But even with that, Karrueche said Deion would still be down to drop that bag and pay for her new girls. However, his offer does come ONE major catch, y’all! Karrueche claimed that Deion told her that if they ever call it quits, he wants those breasts back. He wants her to hand them right over.
 Social Media Weighs In On Karrueche’s Plastic Surgery Plans
 Fans couldn’t help but CUT UP in The Pop Exchange’s comment section . Some folks sided with Deion, agreeing that Karrueche is fine just the way she is. Meanwhile, others couldn’t get enough of her hilarious personality, saying they love seeing this fun side of her.

 Karrueche Spills On Her & Deion’s Playful Bond
 Karrueche has been spilling all the sweet tea about her relationship with Deion Sanders on her new podcast. Recently, she revealed that her favorite part of their romance is that they play all day. “That’s the best part […] we’re joking all the time.” 
 She also opened up about how Deion has been adjusting to life with his new prosthetic toes. Karrueche admitted that she’s been cracking jokes and teasing him about them, but she also gave him his flowers for his resilience and how he never lets life’s challenges keeping him down. “ I love that he never allowed this situation to hinder anything in his life,” Karrueche explained.
